description: Implementation of the NetworkQualityStore class managing network quality cache, retrieval, and observer notifications within the net::nqe::internal namespace.

classes.name: NetworkQualityStore
classes.description: Manages a cache of network quality data, supports adding, retrieving, and observer notification.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds or updates network quality data in the cache, maintaining size constraints, and notifies observers.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves cached network quality data matching a given network ID, considering signal strength.

methods.name: AddNetworkQualitiesCacheObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for cache changes and schedules initial notification.

methods.name: NotifyCacheObserverIfPresent
methods.description: Notifies an observer of current cache state if still registered.
